$description: Exceptions for the dark theme (decision 0054), beside the generated base values in dark.json: the semantic tokens whose reference changes in dark, and the stronger shadows (#354, #355, #356). Hand-written; modes.test.ts checks the theme changes only colour and shadow.

1.$description: Twice the light opacity: shadows barely show on the dark page (#356).

on-fill.$description: Light in dark too: the near-white end of the dark ramp (#355).
Light in dark too, matching text.on-fill (#355).

accent.$description: The most saturated step where text.on-fill meets 4.5:1 in dark (#355; fillStep in dark.json).

danger.$description: The most saturated step where text.on-fill meets 4.5:1 in dark (#355; fillStep in dark.json).

success.$description: The most saturated step where text.on-fill meets 4.5:1 in dark (#355; fillStep in dark.json).

warning.$description: The most saturated step where text.on-fill meets 4.5:1 in dark (#355; fillStep in dark.json).

serious.$description: The most saturated step where text.on-fill meets 4.5:1 in dark (#355; fillStep in dark.json).

accent-hover.$description: Darkens in dark: mixing in the light on-fill colour would take on-fill text below 4.5:1 on a fill that starts at 4.6:1, so the state mixes in text.inverse, which is dark here (P2 over #355's 'lighten in both themes').

accent-pressed.$description: Darkens in dark: mixing in the light on-fill colour would take on-fill text below 4.5:1 on a fill that starts at 4.6:1, so the state mixes in text.inverse, which is dark here (P2 over #355's 'lighten in both themes').

raised.$description: Raised surfaces sit one step above the dark page (#356). In light this is white, which has no dark counterpart (decision 0049).

overlay.$description: Floating layers sit one step above raised in dark (#356).

scrim.$description: The scrim stays dark in dark, and stronger, so the page recedes (#354): the inverse alpha ramp is dark-based here.
